explication: This repository is a Claude Code hooks and agent-orchestration demonstration. Its primary workflow is a Claude Code lifecycle event invoking a hook that can validate or enrich activity, provide feedback, and record event data. The README also describes subagents, team validation, status lines, and output styles. The tree includes a separate Bun task-manager CLI; its command-to-repository and repository-to-SQLite relationships are supported by the sampled source. Hook internals were not sampled, so their links reflect README documentation, not inspected implementations.
